concepts.name: guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a response governed by the guideline authority level assigned to rules in the 'Be concise and conversational' section
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the node's own text does not define the authority level

concepts.name: respond_without_awkward_repetition
concepts.gloss: R is a response that does not awkwardly repeat verbatim elements of the user's prompt

asserts.read_back: responding without awkwardly repeating verbatim elements of the prompt is preferred

closure.reason: the example states a preference against awkward repetition; it does not forbid any response outright, so silence leaves other responses permitted
